title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-17
lineage: AUD > MC > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rare Fillmore tracks that are listenable despite modest audience‑tape quality and many questions about the recording’s authenticity.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a couple of uncommon Fillmore songs that sound heartfelt and generally listenable, though the AUD source is described as historically poor and only marginally clear. Reviewers are divided, with several flagging serious doubts about the provenance and completeness of the material, leading to an overall mixed impression.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers note the rarity and decent performance but repeatedly criticize the recording's authenticity and technical limitations; weighting show (≈3) and recording (≈2.5) yields a mid‑range score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: AUD cassette from early 1970s, generally considered poor but this specific tape is listenable with some ambient crowd noise; no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; reviewers only note the rarity of the songs and wish for more material.
